references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 arts.90(2), 91; Decree 74/2024/NĐ-CP art.3 (the version’s rules.minimum_wage.by_region). An entity without a recorded region is checked against Region IV, the lowest floor; part-time, probation (at least 85% of the job wage, art.26) and intern terms are outside the monthly check.
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(b): overtime may not exceed 40 hours a month. Counted: derived overtime on working days, and every paid hour on a rest day or public holiday.
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(a): overtime at most 50% of the normal hours of a day; under a weekly regime normal plus overtime hours at most 12 a day.

Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.102(3): the monthly deduction may not exceed 30% of the monthly wage actually paid after compulsory social insurance, health insurance, unemployment insurance and personal income tax.

Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(b): at most 200 hours a year; art.107(3): 300 hours in the sectors and cases listed, after notifying the provincial labour authority (art.107(4); Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP arts.61–62). Counted from hours.year: all overtime (banked included; every hour on a 0-hour rest day) plus the planned hours worked on public, substitute and double holidays, each hour once.
Decree 74/2024/NĐ-CP arts.3–4: the minimum wage is the region of the employer’s place of operation.

Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP art.3, art.4(2)–(3): an hourly wage is at least the regional hourly minimum. A daily wage converted to an hour (over the normal hours of the day) or to a month (over the normal working days of the month) may not fall below the hourly or monthly minimum.
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.25: at most 180 days for an enterprise manager, 60 for a college-level job, 30 for an intermediate or technical job, 6 working days for any other.

Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.137(1)(a): unless she agrees, no night work, overtime or long business trips from the seventh month of pregnancy (sixth in remote areas) or while raising a child under 12 months. Read on employee.children (estimated_delivery_date three months ahead, child_birthdate) and the day’s consent (work.days[].overtime_consented, the work-day sheet’s per-day consent column: owner ruling, consent is per day, never an employee fact).

Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.146(1)(b): a worker from 15 to under 18 works at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, overtime and night work only in the jobs the Minister lists (term fact minor_listed_job).
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.111(1): at least 24 consecutive hours of rest each week; where the cycle does not allow it, at least four days a month on average (entity fact rest_averaged_monthly).
Labour Code 2019 art.105(1)–(2): normal working hours at most 8 a day and 48 a week; under a weekly arrangement at most 10 a day (term fact normal_hours_arrangement).
Labour Code 2019 art.105(1)–(2): at most 48 normal hours a week.
Labour Code 2019 art.107(2)(b): overtime at most 50% of the normal hours of a day; under a weekly arrangement normal plus overtime at most 12 a day.
Labour Code 2019 art.110: a shift worker rests at least 12 hours before moving to another shift.
Labour Code 2019 art.111(1): at least 24 consecutive hours of rest each week; where the work cycle does not allow it, four days a month on average (entity fact rest_averaged_monthly).

Labour Code 2019 art.146: under 15 at most 4 hours a day and 20 a week, no overtime or night work; from 15 to under 18 at most 8 a day and 40 a week, overtime and night work only in the jobs the Minister lists (term fact minor_listed_job); night is 22:00–06:00 (art.106).

Labour Code 2019 art.137(1): no night work, overtime or long business trips from the seventh month of pregnancy (estimated delivery within three months on employee.children) or while raising a child under 12 months, unless she agrees (day.overtime_consented, the sheet’s per-day consent: owner ruling, consent is per day).

Labour Code 2019 art.145(3): the employer may not recruit or use a person under 13, except in arts, physical training or sports work that does not harm the child, with the provincial labour authority’s consent (term fact child_arts_sports_approved).
